name: You Only Need a 3x3 AZ 2023
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YouOnlyNeeda3x3AZ2023#20697-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/380588094020424/) to hear about competitions in Arizona before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!
